[![Deploy](https://www.herokucdn.com/deploy/button.svg)](https://heroku.com/deploy?template=https://github.com/im-parsa/livesoccer) # LiveSoccer (football-standing) > The Open-Source Live Football Standing

## 🤝 Contributing 1. [Fork the repository](https://github.com/im-parsa/LiveSoccer/fork) 2. Clone your fork: `git clone https://github.com/your-username/LiveSoccer.git` 3. Create your feature branch: `git checkout -b my-new-feature` 4. Stage changes `git add .` 5. Commit your changes: `cz` OR `npm run commit` do not use `git commit` 6. Push to the branch: `git push origin my-new-feature` 7. Submit a pull request ## 📝 Credits [@im-parsa](https://github.com/im-parsa)
